note: Caddo Parish has no public parcel service found. The only ArcGIS parcel layer ('Parcels - LA - Caddo Parish', romlc LA_Assessors MapServer/3) returns 'Token Required'. Parish Public Works refers GIS requests to NLCOG (no public service found) and parcel data to the Assessor (actdatascout.com returns a 403 WAF error, no public download). Commercial vendors (Dynamo Spatial, Regrid, Equator) are not county-published, so not used.
